name: Ultrawings 2: Gold Edition
summary:
**Ultrawings 2 Gold Edition** adds a substantial amount of visual upgrades designed to take full advantage of the power of Meta Quest 3+.  And with over 300 missions you'll get lost in the world of Ultrawings 2 for well over 30 hours (40+ for you completionists).  

Experience the epic flight game that was rated 9/10 by RoadtoVR and received an Essential rating by UploadVR in a brand new light!
